design_choices.LOADX: the 3 LOAD extras (g_3d, g_7d, min_l5_vs_base) + the 7 LOAD_TRACK columns, as the rule's H1 lists them; LOADX+SCHEDULE+TRAVEL = the 22

descriptive.label: Descriptive (cannot pass or fail the rule): per-number 95% CI, not multiplicity-adjusted

T452_rejudged.note: per-number 95%, not multiplicity-adjusted; descriptive, cannot rescue or fail the rule; a T452 annotation, not a new pass
T452_rejudged.reading: T452's failed condition would have held under a valid placebo; with the knockouts naming LOAD, T452 becomes 'LOAD (recent-role minutes) carries a pts gain', i.e. FULL (a T452 annotation, not a new pass)

arm_saw_it.note: share 0 = the arm never read the 22 columns (pipeline fault, not a null)

verdict.null_statement: no effect larger than -0.0043 (the 2024 CI lower bound of WF - FULL, n 27701 rows / 1320 games)

gate.test: frame identity: sha256 of the A0 rows x 71 columns equals the frozen pin
HOLDOUT_ACCESS_LOG: no row names WORKLOAD_PTS_V2; no 2025 loader
W6: past-only placebo NaN iff no earlier played row in the player-season (whole frame); A0 NaN rows vs n_season == 0
join coverage: the 22 columns attach to every A0 row; NULL share per column
gate.threshold: all rows found; every column null share < 2%

gate.test: missingness of the 22 by realised-minutes bucket (pp)
reproduction: P0C == stored components; FULL refit == heads_pts_R.npz; FULL pi refit == pi_R.npz (or data drift: every arm refit, reported)
positive control: FULL - A0 reproduces T467 (harness can move)
planted same-game: rows of the edited day identical
control: rows after the edited day change
planted future: rows dated on or before the cutoff identical
planted future (schedule): rows up to the cutoff identical
planted future (heads, WF): centre/scale of rows in blocks before the cutoff identical
control (heads, WF): rows in later blocks change

gate.threshold: >= 300 to count (a smaller slice is reported and cannot fail)
